w: Bete Giyorgis is cut straight down into the rock in the shape of a Greek cross, its roofline level with the ground. One of eleven monolithic churches at Lalibela, the site was originally called Roha before it took the name of King Lalibela, its builder, later venerated as a saint by the Ethiopian Orthodox Church.
